baseline_models.reading: The focus presents human origination as an act of creation from ʿalaq: ordinarily, clotted and clinging bodily material. The human is made, with the source phrase keeping material dependence in view.

focus_anchor.role: This complete verbal clause states the focus's creation, human object, and from-source relation.

activation_trace.role: Its supplied image is originating and bringing into being, which grounds the creation predicate.
Its supplied image of visible human presence supports the ordinary human referent.
Its supplied image of clotted blood and a blood-sucking leech keeps the ordinary clotted, adhering material sense available for عَلَقٍ.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verb خَلَقَ takes ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ as its object and مِنْ عَلَقٍ as its source phrase. The cited creation and clotted-material images therefore yield a concise statement of human making from a dependent bodily beginning.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three root occurrences and their unranked branch inventories. I use the ordinary syntax of the focus clause to relate creator, human, and source; no additional historical or biomedical claim is needed. Other mapped branches remain live lexical possibilities but are not required for this baseline.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this as an ordinary origin statement. It does not settle a technical account of embryology, nor does it license treating every branch mapped to خ ل ق, ء ن س, or ع ل ق as a simultaneous meaning of the focus form.

context_deltas.reading: The created human is also presented as the recipient of teaching that it did not previously possess, so the focus can be read as the beginning of a creation-and-instruction sequence under the Lord.

focus_anchor.role: The human created in the focus is explicitly named again as the recipient of teaching.

activation_trace.role: The repeated originating image resumes the focus's creation predicate at the start of the surrounding sequence.
The supplied human-presence image marks the same lexical human target in the teaching clause.
Its supplied image is knowing, learning, and teaching, making the formerly unknown knowledge the operative extension.

structural_cues.role: The window opens with reading in the Lord's name and the relative clause identifying Him as creator.
The focus specifies the human creation that the adjacent creation clause leaves general.
The same relative-clause sequence turns from creation to teaching.
It names the human and contrasts instruction with prior non-knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is repeated at the window's opening, and the immediately following clauses name teaching by the same Lord and teaching of the same lexical human. The focus consequently expands from bodily origination alone to creaturely reception of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The focus reads as a statement of where the human comes from.
changed_reading.after: Within 96:1-5, that origin is paired with the human's being taught what it did not know.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated خلق, the repeated ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ, and the teaching clauses. I infer a purposeful sequence from their order and parallel syntax; the packet does not itself state a developmental chronology or a causal theory of learning. A live alternative is to read the clauses as coordinated praise rather than a temporal progression.
context_deltas.containment: Do not make the pen clause a claim about a particular educational technology or period. The retained point is the textually visible conjunction of creation, human non-knowledge, and teaching.

context_deltas.reading: The clinging origin becomes a corrective to self-sufficiency: the human from عَلَقٍ is later said to overstep when it sees itself as sufficient, and the sequence recalls return to the Lord.

focus_anchor.role: The from-source phrase supplies the focus's image of dependent, adhering origin for the later contrast.

activation_trace.role: The repeated human image connects the later diagnosis directly to the focus's human.
Its supplied image is overstepping the bound in rebellion, specifying the human response under examination.
Its supplied image of self-sufficiency and wealth supplies the stated trigger for overstepping.
Its supplied image is return or sending back, giving the sequence its counter-movement.

structural_cues.role: The focus gives the human's dependent material beginning.
The same named human is diagnosed as overstepping.
This gives the human's seeing itself as sufficient as the stated occasion.
The following line redirects the movement toward return to the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ, followed by overstepping because of perceived sufficiency and then return, lets the focus's from-attachment origin work as a counter-image to autonomous self-possession. This is a sequence-based ethical activation, not a replacement of the material origin sense.

changed_reading.before: The focus is primarily an account of human material origin.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding sequence makes that origin a check on the human posture of self-sufficiency and overreach.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies the shared human term, overstepping, self-sufficiency, and return. I infer the contrast between عَلَقٍ and self-sufficiency from their ordered placement rather than from an explicit connective equating them. A live alternative is that 96:6 begins a new warning whose relation to 96:2 is thematic but not argumentative.
context_deltas.containment: Keep the ordinary clotted-material reading primary. Downstream prose should say that the context can make origin function as a corrective, not that عَلَقٍ lexically means moral dependence or that every individual act of self-sufficiency is in view.

context_deltas.reading: The created human can be read, more tentatively, as a creature whose non-self-sufficient posture is enacted through a servant's prayer, refusal of coercive obedience, prostration, and approach.

focus_anchor.role: The focus's human term is the point to which the later enacted human posture is returned.

activation_trace.role: Its supplied image of worship and submissive obedience makes the servant's prayer a relational posture rather than a bare social label.
Its supplied image is prescribed worship with its postures, specifying what the servant is being prohibited from doing.
Its supplied image of obedient yielding makes the negative command a rejection of the coercer's claim to obedience.
Its supplied image is lowering in humble submission, giving the response a bodily enactment.
Its supplied image of devotional approach and offering lets the final imperative complete the posture as approach.

structural_cues.role: The focus supplies the creaturely human whose origin is at issue.
The contested action is a servant's prayer.
The final three imperatives contrast not obeying the prohibitor with prostration and approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the warning about human self-sufficiency, the window shows a human conflict around prayer and ends by redirecting obedience into prostration and approach. That enacted sequence can extend the focus's creaturely origin into a relational posture rather than leaving it as material description alone.

changed_reading.before: The focus defines the human by created material origin.
changed_reading.after: The later scene allows that createdness to be read as calling for a posture of prayerful humbling and approach rather than obedience to a human prohibitor.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the prayer scene and its final imperatives, but it does not grammatically identify the focus's general ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ with the servant or the addressee. I supply the cross-window generalization from the short sequence. A live alternative treats the commands as a local response to a particular conflict without extending them to the focus's anthropology.
context_deltas.containment: This is exploratory because the referent link is not explicit. Do not claim that 96:2 itself commands prayer, or that every lexical branch for servant, prayer, obedience, prostration, and approach is activated by the surface forms.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: At the image level, عَلَقٍ can retain attachment as well as clotted source-material; beside the later threatened seizing of the forelock, it can evoke a defiant human as bodily non-autonomous—originating in attachment and liable to be taken by the head.

focus_anchor.role: The focus noun has a supplied branch for something clinging or hanging on another, which permits attachment to remain a secondary image.

activation_trace.role: Its supplied image is something clinging to, sticking in, or hanging from another thing; that is the focus-side attachment image.
Its supplied image is seizing by the forelock with coercive force, providing the later bodily counter-image.
Its supplied image is the forelock and taking it, making the threatened grip explicit.

structural_cues.role: The focus gives the origin side of the material analogy.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
structural_cues.role: The conditional threat supplies the later act of forcible forelock-seizing.
The next line characterizes the forelock in terms of falsehood and wrongdoing.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: This is a material analogy, not a claim that the two roots are identical. The focus's attachment image becomes a bodily counterpoint to the later forelock-grip after refusal to desist, so creaturely contingency is visually intensified across the window.

changed_reading.before: عَلَقٍ is retained only as source-material in the origin statement.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that ordinary sense, the focus can carry a qualified image of human non-autonomy across the later threatened grip.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet does not say that عَلَقٍ means forelock or explicitly signals a parallel. I supply the analogy between clinging attachment and bodily seizure because both are concrete images tied back to the focus human. The live alternative is to retain only the ordinary clotted-material reading and treat 96:15-16 as an independent threat scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects unrelated roots with no lexical repetition, yet it remains anchored in two supplied physical images. Downstream prose must frame it as a possible evocation, never as the lexical meaning of عَلَقٍ or as a settled intended correspondence.

summary.ordinary_reading: 96:2 says that God created the human from عَلَقٍ; the cited inventory supports an ordinary clotted, clinging bodily-origin reading.
coexisting_readings: Within 96:1-5, the created human is also the one taught what it did not know, so origin and received knowledge form a supported sequence.
Within 96:6-8, the same human's perceived self-sufficiency, overreach, and return let the origin statement function as a supported corrective to autonomy.
More tentatively, the prayer and final imperatives make creaturely origin readable as a posture of refusing coercive obedience, prostrating, and approaching.
An exploratory physical analogy links the focus's attachment image to the later threatened forelock-grip; it supplements rather than displaces the ordinary source-material reading.
unresolved_limits: The packet records no source gaps, but its root mappings and branch inventories are unranked; uncited lexical branches cannot automatically be treated as meanings of the quoted forms.
The orientation is non-citable and contains no out-of-window ayat, so this reconstruction relies only on the displayed window.
The cross-ayah causal and rhetorical links are reader inferences from wording, sequence, and supplied images; no external tafsir, chronology, or historical identification has been used.
